UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user wallet profile in ASTERA Digital Banking simulation.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

name.description: Full display name of the user.

phone.description: Indonesian phone number starting with 08 (10 to 13 digits).

email.description: Email address associated with the user account.

photoUrl.description: Optional profile photo URL or local URI string.

UserDirectoryEntry.title: UserDirectoryEntry
UserDirectoryEntry.description: Minimal searchable recipient lookup record for P2P transfer and QR resolution.

searchable.description: Must be true for recipient search queries.

UserSecret.title: UserSecret
UserSecret.description: Private hashed 6-digit PIN and lockout metadata isolated from public profiles.

pinHash.description: Salted SHA-256 hash of the user's 6-digit transaction PIN.

lockUntilMs.description: Epoch milliseconds until transfer PIN lock expires (0 if unlocked).

TransactionRecord.title: TransactionRecord
TransactionRecord.description: Immutable simulated transfer or multi-bank top up transaction.

receiverId.description: UID of the recipient user (or same as senderId for topup).

outOfBudget.description: True if transaction exceeded remaining monthly budget.

splitDetail.description: Multi-bank debit breakdown for topup transactions.

MonthlyBudget.title: MonthlyBudget
MonthlyBudget.description: Per-user monthly spending budget limit and spent counter.

monthlyLimit.description: Monthly spending cap in integer IDR.

monthKey.description: Current tracking month in YYYY-MM format.

spentThisMonth.description: Accumulated spending for monthKey in integer IDR.

BankAccount.title: BankAccount
BankAccount.description: Simulated linked bank account used as funding source for Multi-Bank Split top up.

bankName.description: Bank display name (e.g., Bank Alpha, Bank Beta).

balance.description: Current simulated bank balance in integer IDR (>= 0).

/users/{userId}.description: User wallet profile keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/user_directory/{userId}.description: Recipient lookup directory for P2P transfers and QR resolution.

/user_secrets/{userId}.description: Owner-only hashed PIN and lockout state.

/transactions/{transactionId}.description: Immutable simulated transfer and top up transaction records.

/budgets/{userId}.description: User monthly spending budget document keyed by UID.

/bank_accounts/{bankId}.description: Simulated external bank accounts owned by the user.
